32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol bright palette and clean card grid show design intent, but 5 of 9 cells render as blank white boxes in the screenshot, making the gallery look broken rather than functional.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: A technique demo with honest encoding throughout — zero baselines correct on all bar/area forms, stacked height math is correct for linear scales, pack layout gives area-proportional circles — but all domains are hardcoded constants ([0,1], [0,1.2]) rather than data-driven, and no key functions are used in data joins, keeping it out of the 8+ tier.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: No user interactions exist (pure auto-loop animations), making Update Storm, Infinite Loop, and Mouse-Touch Fight N/A; the only minor risk is the absence of .interrupt() guards in loopMorph before starting new transitions, though sequential callback chaining prevents actual conflicts in normal operation.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: Nine spatially isolated cells with independent animations keep cross-cell cognitive load low, but 6 of 9 cells appear blank in the screenshot (likely a mid-animation timing artifact), and full perceptual quality of 9 simultaneous looping morphs cannot be assessed without motion.
